sites.stratum: Hyperarid red dune, sparse shrubs and a sandy walking track

reference_photos.use: Sparse vegetation, sandy approach and dune slope near the pinned path

checks: Preserve broad bare sand and sparse shrubs
Check the footpath shoulder and sand grain at grazing angles
evidence_gaps: Local wind-shaped microrelief, shrub cover and minerals within the dune sand

sites.stratum: Managed subtropical freshwater wetland with embankments and wooded margins

reference_photos.use: Water, reed and woody canopy cover in the winter wetland

checks: Separate wet shore, emergent cover and dry embankment
Keep the raised lane continuous at the water edge
evidence_gaps: Photo location within the park and managed water level at the scene time
Surface tags for the two tracks and polygon coverage of the photographed wetland
WorldCover classifies the near camera cell as cropland and the stand cell as grass

sites.stratum: Managed temperate heather and scattered junipers on sandy ground

reference_photos.use: August heather, juniper silhouettes and wooded margins in the basin

checks: Distinguish heather, grass, juniper and woodland in the managed mosaic
Check exposed sand and the soft shoulder beside low heath
evidence_gaps: Exact photo pose and site-specific burn, grazing and cutting history

sites.stratum: Subtropical freshwater marsh, limestone and a paved wetland path

reference_photos.use: Summer water and marsh plants by the pinned Anhinga Trail

checks: Check vegetation rooted at the solved shoreline
Preserve open water and keep the paved path clear
evidence_gaps: Water stage and marsh biomass at the scene time

sites.stratum: Temperate coastal dune scrub above quartz sand and exposed granite

reference_photos.use: Quartz beach, coastal scrub and rock at the nearshore path

checks: Separate quartz sand, granite and dune scrub
Check vegetation density and footing along the sheltered sand path
evidence_gaps: Tide stage and the vegetation line around the creek at the scene time
The coastal stand cell has no ecoregion or SoilGrids prior

sites.stratum: Wet-season freshwater lagoons and sparsely vegetated tropical dune sand

reference_photos.use: Seasonal lagoon, exposed sand and low cover in the Barreirinhas dune field

checks: Keep active sand bodies sparse
Check relief and the extent of mapped water independently of the vegetation recipe
evidence_gaps: Exact photo pose and changing seasonal lagoon outlines and water levels

sites.stratum: East African montane forest on a steep waterfall gorge and rocky footpath

reference_photos.use: Gura gorge canopy, moss-covered boles and exposed rock at the Karuru lookout

checks: Compare cliff exposure with the opposite wooded slope
Check roots on steep ground and preserve the footpath
evidence_gaps: The lookout is identified by place name without surveyed camera coordinates
Local tree composition and gorge-scale canopy heights need field evidence

sites.stratum: Subtropical alluvial grassland and seasonally wet Rapti floodplain with wooded margins

reference_photos.use: Spring water, emergent cover and wooded banks at the photographed Rapti reach near the fixed cameras

checks: Distinguish floodplain grasses, wooded cover and exposed alluvium
Keep emergents and wet ground consistent with mapped and solved water contacts
evidence_gaps: The recorded photo is within 145 m of both cameras and has a different eye position and shoreline water level
Exact inundation, alluvial texture and management history of the capture are unknown
SoilGrids has no texture prior at the stand camera, and the mapped track there has no surface tag

sites.stratum: Subarctic mountain birch woods with damp forest floor near the lower Kungsleden

reference_photos.use: Summer mountain birch habit, low green undergrowth and moist path margins in Abisko

checks: Check low, irregular birches and summer understory density
Keep footpath support continuous at the sloping woodland edge
evidence_gaps: The birch reference is dated by camera metadata and lacks a precise pose
Board or litter coverage and local soil wetness are unresolved

sites.stratum: Tidal mangrove scrub, pine flatwoods margin and coastal footpaths in Tampa Bay

reference_photos.use: Low mangrove canopy, open sandy patches and vegetation structure in the preserve

checks: Check low tidal woodland next to dry ground and open water
Reserve walkable paths and distinguish aerial roots from dry woodland roots
evidence_gaps: The dated photograph has no exact pose or recording of tide level
WorldCover labels the camera cells as woodland and maps mangroves around them
The fixed cameras use at-grade paths because the model lacks a solved deck at the surveyed boardwalk stations

sites.stratum: Restored temperate valley forest at an urban reservoir and maintained paths

reference_photos.use: Autumn lower dam, regenerating canopy and the edge between planted and maintained ground

checks: Compare the restored canopy with the managed dam margin
Check fern and shrub layering while keeping the mapped route clear
evidence_gaps: Species distribution and planting dates within the visible stand have not been established
The photo is a nearby dam view and the fixed cameras remain on solved at-grade footpaths

sites.stratum: High Andean bunchgrass páramo with volcanic terrain and glacial lake margins

reference_photos.use: Rain-darkened páramo, low cover, bare rock and lake margins in overcast light

checks: Keep bunchgrass, low shrubs, exposed bedrock and standing water distinct
Check slopes and ground transitions from the mapped footpath
evidence_gaps: The comparison records rain on one day. Cloud-base height, soil moisture and long-term water level are unknown
Local species cover and mineral surface colour need closer evidence
